review:
The fisherman heads to the Amazon, and this time you get a say in the bonus. The base game is the usual 5x3, 10-line Big Bass, with some new jungle symbols, and fish carry cash values collected in the feature.

Before free spins, you pick from modifiers – extra fish, extra fishermen, starting on level two and more – so you can shape the round. Collecting fishermen raises the multiplier as usual. No published max win, and a lower 96.07% RTP than the original.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
